models_evaluated: HIPAA-compliant EHR-integrated large language model (Stanford Health Care)

links.outcome: Time measures, clinician task load and work exhaustion after AI draft reply pilot
links.effect: No change in reply action, write, or read time; task load score fell 61.31 to 47.26 (P<.001); work exhaustion fell 1.95 to 1.62 (P<.001).
links.quote: There was no change in reply action time, write time, or read time between the prepilot and pilot periods.

screen.reason: This prospective QI pilot evaluated the real-world clinical deployment of an EHR-integrated LLM generating draft responses to patient inbox messages, assessing utilization, time metrics, and clinician burden/burnout.
